longTitle.officialTitle: To redesignate the Jimmy Carter National Historic Site as the “Jimmy Carter National Historical Park”.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Jimmy Carter National Historical Park Redesignation Act”.

section.heading: DESIGNATION OF JIMMY CARTER NATIONAL HISTORICAL PARK.

subsection.heading: In General.—
subsection.content: The Jimmy Carter National Historic Site shall be known and designated as the “Jimmy Carter National Historical Park”.

subsection.heading: Amendments to Public Law 100-206.—
subsection.chapeau: Public Law 100-206 (54 U.S.C. 320101 note; 101 Stat. 1434) is amended—

paragraph.content: in section 1(a), in the matter preceding paragraph (1), by striking “National Historic Site” and inserting “National Historical Park”;

subparagraph.content: in subsection (a), by striking “provisions of law generally applicable to national historic sites” and inserting “provisions of law generally applicable to units of the National Park System”; and
in subsection (d), in the second sentence, by striking “National Historic Site” and inserting “National Historical Park”;

paragraph.content: in section 6(2), by striking “National Historic Site” and inserting “National Historical Park”;
by striking “historic site” each place it appears and inserting “historical park”;
by striking “historic site” each place it appears and inserting “historical park”; and
by striking “Historic Site” each place it appears and inserting “Historical Park”.

subsection.heading: References.—
subsection.content: Any reference in any law, regulation, document, record, map, or other paper of the United States to the Jimmy Carter National Historic Site shall be considered to be a reference to the “Jimmy Carter National Historical Park”.
